√hi 'impel'
present: [5.] hinvé etc. hinviré -- [1.] hínvati etc. V.+ -- jighhyati jighhyatu -- háyant -- hiṣe (1s.) 
perfect: jighāya jighyus B.+ 
aorist: [1.] áhema hiyāná hīyāt -- [2.] ahyam? -- [3.] ajīhayat -- [4.] ahaiṣīt áhait aheṣata 
future: [1.] heṣyati etc. E.+ -- [2.] hetā 
verbal: hitá V.+ -hyè passive: hīyate -- intensive: jeghīya- -- desiderative: jighīṣa- -- causative: hāyaya- 
derivatives: háya V.+ -héya AV.B. -hit B. -hiti RV. hetí V.+ hetú V.+ hétva RV. hetavya C. hetṛ RV. -héman V.B. hemán RV. hítvan RV. hinvá RV. héṣas? RV. -hāyyà AV. 
Probably another form of √hā, with causative value. Some of its uses are equivalent with those of √hā; and the stem jighya perhaps belongs directly to the latter.
